title: 24-ounce gold specimen from Little Jonny Mine (found 1892)
label: 24-ounce gold specimen found at the Little Jonny (Ibex) Mine in 1892.
sourceTitle: Gold (Little Jonny Mine, Breece Hill, Leadville, Colorado, USA) (17161825282).jpg
sourceNote: This is a modern photograph of a genuine 24-ounce gold specimen found in 1892 at the Little Jonny Mine, also called Ibex Mine. The specimen was photographed on public display at the Leadville Mining Museum on 29 July 2007. Supplemental Explore media only; do not treat as a historical mine exterior or hero image.
